zcode.name: ZCode
zcode.description: Z.ai coding agent with terminal UI, extensible tools, and workflow orchestration

native.command:
set -eu
agentmgr_zcode_source="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/agentmgr/zcode"
if [ -e "$HOME/.local/bin/zcode" ] || [ -L "$HOME/.local/bin/zcode" ]; then
  printf "%s\n" "zcode already exists in ~/.local/bin; use its existing installation to update" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$agentmgr_zcode_source")" "$HOME/.local/bin"
if [ -d "$agentmgr_zcode_source/.git" ]; then
  test "$(git -C "$agentmgr_zcode_source" remote get-url origin)" = "https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode.git"
  git -C "$agentmgr_zcode_source" pull --ff-only
else
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode.git "$agentmgr_zcode_source"
fi
cd "$agentmgr_zcode_source"
pnpm bootstrap
pnpm --filter @zcode/cli... build
chmod u+x "$agentmgr_zcode_source/apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs"
node "$agentmgr_zcode_source/apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs" --version
ln -s "$agentmgr_zcode_source/apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs" "$HOME/.local/bin/zcode"
native.update_cmd:
set -eu
agentmgr_zcode_source="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/agentmgr/zcode"
cd "$agentmgr_zcode_source"
git pull --ff-only
pnpm bootstrap
pnpm --filter @zcode/cli... build
chmod u+x "$agentmgr_zcode_source/apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs"
node "$agentmgr_zcode_source/apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs" --version

metadata.install_note: Builds the CLI from source into the AgentManager data directory and links ~/.local/bin/zcode; requires Node.js and pnpm. Published desktop assets are not CLI installers.

symphony.description: Experimental issue-driven orchestration runtime for isolated coding-agent work

native.command:
set -eu
case "$(uname -s):$(uname -m)" in
  Darwin:arm64|Darwin:aarch64) agentmgr_symphony_target=macos_arm64 ;;
  Darwin:x86_64) agentmgr_symphony_target=macos_x86_64 ;;
  Linux:aarch64|Linux:arm64) agentmgr_symphony_target=linux_arm64 ;;
  Linux:x86_64) agentmgr_symphony_target=linux_x86_64 ;;
  *) printf '%s\n' 'Unsupported Symphony release platform' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
agentmgr_symphony_tag=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/openai/symphony/releases/latest | jq -er '.tag_name')
agentmgr_symphony_asset="symphony-$agentmgr_symphony_tag-$agentmgr_symphony_target"
agentmgr_symphony_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$agentmgr_symphony_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cd "$agentmgr_symphony_tmp"
curl -fsSLo "$agentmgr_symphony_asset" "https://github.com/openai/symphony/releases/download/$agentmgr_symphony_tag/$agentmgr_symphony_asset"
curl -fsSLo "$agentmgr_symphony_asset.sha256" "https://github.com/openai/symphony/releases/download/$agentmgr_symphony_tag/$agentmgr_symphony_asset.sha256"
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sha256sum -c "$agentmgr_symphony_asset.sha256"
else
  shasum -a 256 -c "$agentmgr_symphony_asset.sha256"
fi
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
test ! -L "$HOME/.local/bin/symphony"
install -m 0755 "$agentmgr_symphony_asset" "$HOME/.local/bin/symphony"

metadata.install_note: Engineering preview. Installs a stable self-contained Unix release with checksum verification. Supply a configured WORKFLOW.md and tracker credentials separately; no version probe is run.

open-scion.name: open_scion
open-scion.description: Experimental community source-control system for coding agents with the Graft CLI

native.command:
set -eu
agentmgr_open_scion_source="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/agentmgr/open-scion"
if [ -e "$HOME/.local/bin/graft" ] || [ -L "$HOME/.local/bin/graft" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'graft already exists in ~/.local/bin; use its existing installation to update' >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$agentmgr_open_scion_source")" "$HOME/.local/bin"
if [ -d "$agentmgr_open_scion_source/.git" ]; then
  test "$(git -C "$agentmgr_open_scion_source" remote get-url origin)" = "https://github.com/feder-cr/git-ai.git"
  git -C "$agentmgr_open_scion_source" pull --ff-only
else
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/feder-cr/git-ai.git "$agentmgr_open_scion_source"
fi
cd "$agentmgr_open_scion_source"
make build
test -x "$agentmgr_open_scion_source/_build/bin/graft"
ln -s "$agentmgr_open_scion_source/_build/bin/graft" "$HOME/.local/bin/graft"
native.update_cmd:
set -eu
agentmgr_open_scion_source="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/agentmgr/open-scion"
test "$(git -C "$agentmgr_open_scion_source" remote get-url origin)" = "https://github.com/feder-cr/git-ai.git"
cd "$agentmgr_open_scion_source"
git pull --ff-only
make build

metadata.install_note: Early v0.1.0 source build; not Anthropic Scion. Builds bundled Git and links graft into ~/.local/bin. Requires Go 1.26, a C toolchain, Meson and Ninja. Configure and run a Graft server separately; no version probe is run.
